name: Sumatran rhinoceros
desc: A critically small population lives in the park. Wikipedia reports a 2011 camera-trap survey and an estimate of no more than 27 animals.
about: The Sumatran rhinoceros, also known as the Sumatran rhino, hairy rhinoceros or Asian two-horned rhinoceros, is a rare member of the family Rhinocerotidae and one of five extant species of rhinoceros;…
